# Renewals for Life

> Renewals for Life (renewalsforlife.com) is a free educational resource from Dreams Business Resources that demonstrates — with an interactive calculator — why compounding lifetime renewal (residual) income dramatically outperforms one-time transactional (linear) income over a career, and how income can keep paying after you stop working.

## What this site teaches

- **Transactional (linear) income**: you are paid once for each sale or hour worked. When you stop working, income stops immediately.
- **Residual (renewal) income**: you are paid again every year a client renews. Each year of work adds a new layer of lifetime renewal income on top of prior years' layers, so income compounds while working and keeps paying at its peak level after you stop.
- **The illustrative example**: with $250,000 Year 1 income and both earners stopping after Year 6, the transactional earner totals $1.5M for life, while the residual earner totals $11.25M over 10 years, $41.25M over 30 years, and $71.25M over 50 years — the same skill under a different compensation structure.

## The interactive calculator

Visitors set two inputs — Year 1 income ($50,000 to $500,000) and the year they stop working (Year 1–10) — and instantly see:
- Side-by-side 10, 20, 30 and 50-year income totals for "Mr. Transactional" vs. "Mrs. Residual"
- A year-by-year comparison table for the first decade, including the compounding "gap advantage"

## Audience and call to action

The site is a referral page for prospective residual income builders in the financial services and B2B marketplace. Visitors are invited to watch a short video overview, run their own numbers, and then get back with the person who invited them.

## About the publisher

Dreams Business Resources (DBR) builds effective virtual distribution teams in the financial services and B2B marketplace using an e-business model with online tools, resources, and training.
